# role commands

Every `role` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `role:assign`

Give a user a role (--remove takes it back).

```bash
bin/semitexa role:assign "<role>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--email` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--shared` | no |
| `--remove` | no |

## `role:create`

Create a role that grants permissions (--permission, repeatable).

```bash
bin/semitexa role:create "<name>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--permission` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--shared` | no |

## `role:delete`

Delete a role and take it from everyone who holds it.

```bash
bin/semitexa role:delete "<role>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--shared` | no |

## `role:grant`

Add (--permission) or remove (--revoke) permissions of a role.

```bash
bin/semitexa role:grant "<role>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--permission` | yes |
| `--revoke` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--shared` | no |

## `role:list`

List roles and their permissions (--email: the roles one user holds).

```bash
bin/semitexa role:list
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--email` | yes |
